desc_en: A single, coherent 30-second process story following one recurring hero from Skopje Old Bazaar to a simple home ritual: sourcing mineral clay, mixing the mask, applying it, rinsing, and revealing healthy glow. Same hero, same jar, consistent wardrobe and color palette; grounded, local, signage-free visuals.
music: Warm Balkan-acoustic minimal groove with soft frame drum and gentle guitar, 96 bpm, modern and intimate
voice: female, warm, grounded, Skopje accent, intimate close-mic
vo_mk: Од Старата чаршија, земам чиста глина.
Ја мешам со вода, до кремаста текстура.
По неколку минути, нежно ја испирам.

shots.kf: Skopje Old Bazaar cobblestone lane, signage-free and softly busy in the background. Our hero woman (late 20s, dark brown bob, olive skin) wears the same beige coat and black scarf. She holds one small frosted glass cosmetic jar with a matte silver lid, looking down as she scoops a pinch of pale green clay from a cloth sack into the open jar. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, natural overcast daylight, earthy greens and warm stone tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She carefully taps clay into the jar and closes the lid once. Camera makes a gentle handheld push-in and slight left-to-right drift, keeping her hands and jar centered, realistic 5-second movement.

shots.kf: Interior bathroom at home, same neutral setting for the rest of the film: off-white tiled wall, matte beige countertop, round mirror out of focus, no labels or text anywhere. The hero stands at the counter in the same beige coat now removed, revealing a simple oatmeal knit sweater, same hair and look. She opens the same frosted jar beside a clear glass bowl and pours a small stream of water from a plain tumbler into the bowl. Tight waist-level close-up, 50mm lens, soft window daylight, muted beige/green palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: She pours water once and sets the tumbler down. Camera performs a slow top-down tilt to follow the water into the bowl, ending on the jar and bowl together, smooth and plausible.

shots.kf: Same bathroom counter and angle continuity. The hero’s hands mix the clay and water in the clear bowl using a simple wooden spatula; the mixture turns into a smooth pale-green cream. The frosted jar sits to frame-left, lid placed beside it, both unchanged. The hero’s face is partially visible above the bowl with a calm, focused expression, simple and natural skin texture. Close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft daylight, clean matte highlights, photorealistic and grounded.
shots.motion: She stirs in one continuous circular motion until the mixture thickens visibly. Camera makes a slow lateral slide from right to left, revealing the jar, bowl, and spatula in one connected move.

shots.kf: Same bathroom, same counter, now framed as a mirror-side close-up: the hero faces the mirror (mirror blurred, no text), applying a thin, even layer of the pale-green mask to her cheek with the wooden spatula. The frosted jar remains on the counter in the lower foreground, slightly out of focus but clearly the same object. Her hair, sweater, and lighting remain consistent. Close-up portrait, 50mm lens, soft window daylight, warm beige and muted green tones, photorealistic, natural pores, simple expression.
shots.motion: She draws one smooth stroke of mask across her cheek and lowers the spatula. Camera performs a gentle dolly-in toward her cheek, stopping before it becomes too tight, realistic 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Transform shot in the exact same bathroom, same camera angle and framing as the previous shot (matching position and lens), but after rinsing: the hero’s skin is clean and fresh with a subtle healthy glow, no mask visible. The same frosted jar sits in the same spot on the counter, lid on, unchanged. She lightly touches her cheek with fingertips, relaxed and confident. Close-up portrait, 50mm lens, same soft daylight and beige/green palette, photorealistic, natural skin detail, no glossy AI look.
shots.motion: She gently presses her fingertips to her cheek once and smiles softly. Camera holds the same position and makes a minimal, slow pull-back to reveal jar and her face together, smooth and plausible.
shots.end_kf: Same bathroom and identical framing maintained; the only change is the hero’s clean, glowing skin and the jar now closed. Countertop, tiles, light direction, wardrobe, and object placement remain consistent and signage-free, photorealistic.
